messages:
sylvia: quick heads-up — planning a rollout next Tue that changes how the SDKs send routing/quota headers for tenant-aware routing. this will affect Dedicated customers that rely on explicit routing keys. need short client guidance + console telemetry notes. :wave:
kevin: thanks. high level — what's the behavioral change? will existing header names be rejected?
sylvia: old behavior: SDK sent `x-rd-routing: <route>` and `x-rd-quota: <quota-token>`; new behavior normalizes to `rd-routing`/`rd-quota` (no x- prefix) and adds `rd-routing-version: 2`. server accepts v1 v2 but we want clients to start emitting v2 for better multi-tenant routing.
tara: are we planning a compatibility window? some partners pin SDK versions.
sylvia: yes — grace period: server accepts both v1 and v2 for 30 days after rollout start, then a 7-day warning-only period, then v1 will be deprecated. we'll announce in changelog + console banner.
alex: for SDK PRs, do we change header names by default or behind a feature flag?
sylvia: behind opt-in flag initially: `enable_routing_v2=true` in SDK config. default stays v1 for the grace period. docs will show how to opt-in.
kevin: telemetry ask — console needs to show counts by header version and which customers are still sending v1. can infra produce metrics?
infra-bot: metric pipeline: we can add a tag `routing_version` to request logs and surface a per-tenant breakdown in the console. cost estimate: small (ingest + dashboard panels).
tara: SDK changelog line request: show sample code for migration. also we should mention fallback behavior when server only accepts v2.
sylvia: good call. sample snippet to include in docs:
```python
# python SDK config example
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RD_KEY'), enable_routing_v2=True)
# sets headers: 'rd-routing', 'rd-quota', 'rd-routing-version: 2'
```
```ts
// ts SDK example
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RD_KEY, enableRoutingV2: true })
// sends headers: rd-routing, rd-quota, rd-routing-version: 2
```
alex: we should also add a migration lint in the TS/py linters that flags callers constructing raw `x-rd-*` headers. low-effort safety net.
kevin: question on quota interop: are quota tokens compatible across versions?
sylvia: yes — token format unchanged. only header names/versioning change. server will still honor tokens from v1.
tara: rollout UX: console banner targeted to Dedicated orgs only, with link to a one-click opt-in toggle (devex) so customers can opt into v2 before the cutover. can product wire this?
kevin: product + console will implement the toggle — suggest adding a telemetry event `console_routing_v2_opt_in` so we can measure adoption.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-3217 to add `routing_version` tag to logs and expose a per-tenant time series. ETA 4d.
sylvia: great — for SDK work, i'll open draft PRs for py/ts today with the opt-in flag, tests, and docs. can folks review?
alex: will review the TS PR; plan to add the linter rule as a separate PR. :+1:
kevin: i'll coordinate the console banner + analytics. let's aim to communicate the deprecation timeline in the next customer newsletter. :mailbox_with_mail:
sylvia: thanks everyone. i'll drop a short changelog + migration guide in #docs once PRs are up. :eyes:
